fact: The report for 1 April 2024 - 31 March 2025 states the SARB regulates and oversees BankservAfrica, SAMOS and SADC-RTGS as systemic FMIs and that a stand-alone NPS Bill was being drafted for tabling in Parliament in 2025.
title: National Payment System Regulatory and Oversight Report (1 April 2024 - 31 March 2025)
